destinationStyleAuthority.rule: Use the adult graphic-novel people-rendering register, not this character's identity.

location.rule: The setting is the practical SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY reference desk, reduced to only the objects needed for this portrait.

era.rule: Wardrobe, technology and character energy must read as late 1990s/Y2K without copying a film still.

wardrobeAndAccessories.rule: Use patterned teacher-librarian layers, small oval glasses on a gold chain, simple earrings and an open-book brooch.

physicalReality.rule: Hands, glasses chain, furniture, books, CRT and card catalogue must be anatomically and structurally coherent.

requiredVisualFacts: Miss Geist-inspired mature face with short dark curls, expressive brows, warm intelligent eyes and a slightly amused smile.
Small oval reading glasses on a gold chain, simple earrings and a small gold open-book brooch.
Warm eccentric late-1990s teacher-librarian clothing with an individual patterned blouse and soft jacket or cardigan.
Adult graphic-novel linework, controlled halftone texture, clean skin and electric SUNNYVAiLE accents.
Practical reference-desk objects include a card catalogue, books, desk lamp and beige CRT computer.
prohibitedContradictions: No predecessor face, silver bouffant, burgundy cable-knit uniform or ornate Victorian-library mood.
No glamour-cartoon, cottage-core, fantasy schoolmarm, near-photographic oil painting or generic corporate illustration.
No generated words, labels, nameplates, screen text or readable book-spine text.
No malformed anatomy, glasses, chain, furniture, devices, books or catalogue drawers and no mottled or wet skin.
No copied Clueless frame or costume, random extra people, vehicles, magical props or purposeless clutter.

references.role: Predecessor role and prop continuity only; face and wardrobe are superseded for this pilot.
